security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Yes, TLS/SSL with HSTS enforcement. Industry standard SHA-256 encryption.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Yes, AWS-managed encryption keys for data at rest.

security.name: Content Security Policy (CSP)
security.value: Not implemented - identified as security gap increasing XSS and clickjacking risks.

security.name: SPF/DMARC
security.value: SPF correctly configured, DMARC policy implemented (set to quarantine).

security.name: Third-Party Processor Vetting
security.value: Animoto evaluates third-party processor privacy, security, and confidentiality practices before engagement and executes binding agreements.

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Maintains written policies governing data security, including breach response and incident management.

products.name: Animoto Video Creator
products.data_scope: User-uploaded media (photos, video clips, audio), project metadata, account information
products.notes: Cloud-based platform with collaboration features, screen recording, stock media integration (Getty Images), voiceover recording, and template library. Available as free tier and paid plans.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier with limited exports) plus paid subscription tiers

flags: NO MAJOR CERTIFICATIONS: Lacks SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and other enterprise compliance certifications. No dedicated trust center.
DATA BREACH HISTORY: Significant 2018 data breach affecting approximately 22 million users; infostealer malware detected on systems per UpGuard.
SECURITY GAPS: No Content Security Policy (CSP) header, DNSSEC, or CAA records identified by UpGuard - increases XSS/clickjacking and DNS spoofing risks.
SECURITY RATING: UpGuard rating B (784/950) indicates moderate security posture, not enterprise-grade.
AI TRAINING UNDOCUMENTED: Product offers 'AI video maker' features but no public documentation on whether customer data is used for model training or if opt-out is available.
GROWTH MATURITY: No trust center, no major certifications, suitable for SMB/marketing use but not for regulated industries or sensitive data.
GDPR READY: Positive finding - Standard Contractual Clauses and data protection measures documented for EU compliance.
